items.t: Mid fall, arms out, expression still catching up with the body.
Mid leap off a piece of furniture that was not designed for it.
One character carrying another who did not ask to be carried.
Two people pulling the same bag in opposite directions.
Lifting {4} at full arm's length like something found under a sink.
Sprinting through a doorway, one foot off the ground, hair behind.
Tripping over something small, both arms already compensating.
Dodging a thrown object, back arched, eyes shut.
Catching something one handed without looking, still mid conversation.
Hauling a full bin bag with the whole body, the bag winning.
Shouldering a door open with both hands full.
Piggyback, the carrier regretting it, the passenger delighted.
Standing on a chair to reach something, the chair on two legs.
Ducking under a low beam a second too late.
Frozen mid step on a floorboard that has made a noise.
Spinning to look for something already in their hand.
Hanging off the back of the sofa, upside down, phone still in use.
Reaching for a top shelf while somebody else holds their belt loop.
Crouched on the floor eye to eye with {4}, negotiating.
Launching off the sofa to answer a door nobody knocked on.
Flailing to keep a tray level while walking backwards.
Blocking a doorway with one arm, entirely casual about it.
Yanking headphones off at a sudden noise, cable snapping taut.
Swerving mid stride around {4}, who has not moved.
Collapsing into an armchair, limbs arriving in the wrong order.
A high five that has missed, both hands still in the air.
Dragging someone by the sleeve toward something they must see.
Leaning so far back on a chair that gravity has an opinion.
Both hands up in surrender, holding a cup in one of them.
Braced against a door that something is pushing from the other side.
Balancing three mugs and a plate, tongue out in concentration.
Kneeling to tie a shoe while the others keep walking.
Stretching across two people on a sofa to reach the far cushion.
Vaulting a low fence with less clearance than planned.
Pointing hard at something off frame, mouth open, nobody following the finger.
Recoiling from a plant as though it moved.
Sliding on socks across a hard floor, arms out for balance.
Holding a phone up to show the others, both of whom are looking at something else.
Shielding a laptop from a spill with the whole upper body.
Squeezing three people through a door meant for one, nobody giving way.
